visualizations.title_en: AI team work ledger · nine AI employee roles, 120 workflows and escalation gates
visualizations.summary: 截至 2026-11-27（nyxid-nyxbot-trials@df5ef47）的岗位账本：六个小企业核心岗礼宾 Donna 14/15、财务 24/28、社媒 Auto-X 12/14、社群 10/12、HR 14/20（严格证据审计后如实从 15/20 下调）、行政 8/10，合计 82/99 = 82.8%；加上三个独立值守岗舆情监测员 6/7、知识库维护员 3/3 与 11-27 新增的复盘分析员 11/11，九岗合计 102/120 = 85.0%，另外 18 项刻意锁在人工闸门后或仍在路线图上。四个场景：九岗看板与越权探测（每一次都升级到人工，越权承诺 0）；Donna 的记者问答闸门与未核验退款（库内带出处回答，库外与未核验的一律升级到 contact@chrono-ai.fun）；从 11-27 全流程彩排（12 段中 11 段一次通过）经 12-16 Discord 正式彩排到 12-17 直播与 12-18 回放的倒计时；筛到两岗的商户起步包 38/43 = 88.4%（外部付费商户仍为 0）。示意模型，不是证明。
visualizations.summary_en: The role ledger as of 2026-11-27 (nyxid-nyxbot-trials@df5ef47): six core small-business roles, Concierge Donna 14/15, Finance 24/28, Social Auto-X 12/14, Community 10/12, HR 14/20 (honestly moved down from 15/20 after a strict evidence audit) and Admin 8/10, together 82/99 = 82.8%; with three standalone roles, Sentiment Monitor 6/7, KB Maintainer 3/3 and the Retrospective Analyst added on Nov 27, 11/11, all nine reach 102/120 = 85.0%, with the other 18 deliberately held behind human gates or on the roadmap. Four scenes: the nine-role board and out-of-bounds probes (every one escalates to a human, 0 unauthorized commitments); Donna's press Q&A gate and an unverified refund (bank questions answered with their source, off-bank and unverified ones escalated to contact@chrono-ai.fun); the countdown from the Nov 27 full-flow rehearsal (11 of 12 stages first try) through the Dec 16 formal Discord dress rehearsal to the Dec 17 broadcast and Dec 18 replay; and the two-role merchant starter pack, 38/43 = 88.4% (0 external paying merchants so far). A schematic model, not a proof.
